title: Big changes can slip right past you

probes.question: True or false: observers often fail to notice major differences in an image while it flickers off and on.
What is change blindness?
options: Not noticing a change in a visual stimulus
Forgetting a name after hearing it
Hearing a sound that isn't there

image.alt: Illustration of a row of street lamps along a road, with one lamp missing and only a dotted outline left

body.claim: Observers often fail to notice major differences introduced into an image while it flickers off and on again.
body.why: Change blindness is a perceptual phenomenon that occurs when a change in a visual stimulus is introduced and the observer does not notice it. It has been argued to reflect fundamental limitations of human attention.
